instruction: Open the Add-ons Manager in Thunderbird.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened About Profiles tab by navigating hamburger menu > Help > Troubleshooting Information, scrolling down, and clicking the about:profiles link. Completed in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird hamburger menu, open Help submenu, access Troubleshooting Information, scroll pages, find and click internal about: links to open new tabs.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests same menu navigation capability with a different target: opening the Add-ons Manager (about:addons) tab. Accessible from hamburger menu > Add-ons and Themes, using the same navigation pattern demonstrated in the trajectory.
metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the Add-ons Manager tab in Thunderbird. Evaluator checks accessibility tree for an 'Add-ons Manager' tab in the tabmail-tabs tab list.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_accessibility_tree) correctly extracts the full accessibility tree XML for UI state inspection.
CSS selector correctly targets a page-tab named 'Add-ons Manager' within Thunderbird's tabmail-tabs tab list, which is exactly the UI element created when the Add-ons Manager is opened.
Metric (check_accessibility_tree) correctly parses the XML and applies CSS selectors to verify element existence, returning 1.0 if found and 0.0 otherwise.
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (open Add-ons Manager) is fully verified by checking for the corresponding tab.
No postconfig needed: the Add-ons Manager tab remains open and inspectable after being opened.
